model_substitution.note: Same architecture, prompts, limits, seeds, evidence and gates; a much smaller model, so not a reproduction of the 70B system.

AP3.caveat: These scenarios run on genuine qwen3:4b agent outputs that did NOT pass the pre-registered reliability gates. They are diagnostics of signal transmission, not evidence that the agents are reliable or that AI adds investment value.
AP3.categorical_note: Supported, Contradicted and Insufficient were never scaled. They are encoded and calibrated into a numerical view upstream exactly as in the archived run; only that view is rescaled.

mechanisms_examined.similar_baseline_market_exposure: Supported by the numbers: each approach's 0x scenario is nearly all of its own 1x return series, and the two 0x series are more correlated with each other than the 1x series are.
mechanisms_examined.views_weak_relative_to_the_prior: Measured per approach as the size of the signal-induced part of the view against the allocator's own prior; see transmission.
mechanisms_examined.capped_or_constrained_response: Measured per approach as the share of months with a binding bound and the constraint attenuation share; see transmission.
mechanisms_examined.not_attributable_to_Black_Litterman_alon: JEV does not use the Deterministic model's Black-Litterman path. It applies a capped tilt to its own equilibrium edge, so any shared attenuation has to be explained per architecture, not by one allocator.

cross_approach.separation_note: Signal transmission is not signal predictive quality. These numbers say how much of each portfolio's behaviour comes from its views; they do not say whether those views are informative. The Signal Value-Added study addresses the second question and is not restated here.

limitations: 46 development months. The intervals are wide and none of these comparisons is confirmatory.
Four scenarios for each of three allocators were examined. No multiplicity correction is applied and no bootstrap p-value here is a claim of significance.
The 2x scenario is a diagnostic stress test. It is not a recommendation, and it was not selected on any criterion.
This experiment measures signal transmission, not signal predictive quality. A portfolio can respond strongly to an uninformative view, and a useful view can be attenuated to nothing.
The approaches hold different assets (SPY/IEF/LQD against SPY/TLT) with different neutral portfolios and different risk structures, so weight responses are comparable only in relative terms.

Causal RAG is included only as an EXPLORATORY diagnostic: its genuine qwen3:4b outputs failed both pre-registered reliability gates, so its scenarios describe how its allocator transmits a view, not whether that view is trustworthy.
